== 1998 and 1999 Worlds bags (30 Oct 2026) ==
Jason Kilby posted a photograph of two prize bags on 28 October 2026. One bag is printed DECIPHER CUSTOMIZABLE CARD GAME 1998 WORLD CHAMPIONSHIP VIRGINIA BEACH, VA. The other is printed STAR WARS CUSTOMIZABLE CARD GAME 1999 WORLD CHAMPIONSHIP FINALIST. Distinctive name plus the printed Worlds bags. Dest as a Photographs extra. Identification stays here.
